description: This file defines a set of reusable composable UI components for buttons (filled, outlined, and text variants) using Jetpack Compose in Kotlin. It includes button variants with different content slots (with icons, text, or generic content), internal layout functions, and preview functions for visual testing. The classes and functions primarily wrap Material 3 button components, customizing their appearance and behavior for the specific design system of the project.

methods.name: NiaButton
methods.description: Creates a filled button with customizable onClick behavior, modifier, enabled state, padding, and content slot. Wraps Material 3 Button.

methods.name: NiaButton (overload with text and icon)
methods.description: Creates a filled button with text and optional leading icon content slots, internally calling the base NiaButton.

methods.name: NiaOutlinedButton
methods.description: Creates an outlined button with customizable onClick, modifier, enabled state, padding, and content slot. Wraps Material 3 OutlinedButton.

methods.name: NiaOutlinedButton (with text and icon)
methods.description: Creates an outlined button with text and optional leading icon, using the base NiaOutlinedButton.

methods.name: NiaTextButton
methods.description: Creates a text button with customizable onClick, modifier, enabled state, and content slot. Wraps Material 3 TextButton.

methods.name: NiaTextButton (with text and icon)
methods.description: Creates a text button with text and optional leading icon, using the base NiaTextButton.

methods.name: NiaButtonContent
methods.description: Internal helper that arranges icon and text within a button, ensuring proper spacing and layout.
